title: Send structured data
summary: Express.js: Send structured data. Add a colour field to the object.
introduction: JSON is a text format for named data. GET /book returns a small object.
learningObjectives: Add a colour field to the object

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.

blocks.title: Send structured data

blocks.text: res.json serialises the title and pages fields and sets a JSON response type.
Add a colour field to the object.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use res.json for data so Express sets the JSON content type.
